uplink.description: 0x42 Analog data: ch A 0-10V -> 1.049 V, ch B 4-20mA -> 10.486 mA, ch B alarm set
uplink._note: Both interface channels are sub-sensor positions: one channels[] entry each (labels channelA/channelB), each carrying the vocabulary key its own type nibble selects (channel B is no longer a suffixed extra) plus its own alarm bit.

uplink.description: 0x42 Analog data: both channels 0-10V with distinct values (2.5 V / 7.5 V), ch A alarm set, low battery
0x42 Analog data: ch A 4-20mA -> 10.486 mA, ch B deactivated (no entry)
uplink._note: Type nibble 0 = deactivated: channel B gets no entry (and no alarm flag).

uplink.description: 0x42 Analog data: ch A deactivated, ch B 4-20mA -> 5.243 mA with its alarm set
uplink._note: Skipping a deactivated position never renumbers the remaining one: channel B keeps its own label.

uplink.description: 0x42 Analog data with both channels deactivated carries no measurement
